Name: Bartimaeus
Summary: Bartimaeus was a blind beggar sitting by the roadside near Jericho. Hearing that Jesus of Nazareth passed by, he cried out for mercy, threw aside his garment, and received his sight, then followed Jesus on the way.
KeyStory: Bartimaeus shouted over the crowd, Son of David, have mercy on me, and left his cloak behind when Jesus called.
LifeLesson: The crowd told him to be quiet, and he shouted louder. Mercy belongs to those who will not stop asking.
